items.text: Vikings have ruled out WR Justin Jefferson.
items.opportunity: Target share spike for remaining Vikings WRs.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans carted off then ruled out with rib injury.
items.why: In-game injury; carted to locker room, ruled out.
items.implication: Immediate zero; check severity for multi-week.

items.text: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley: early eval of Achane knee 'does not sound very optimistic'; still gathering info, fear of major injury.
items.why: Postgame comments indicate significant knee damage possible.
items.implication: Handcuff/backup elevation critical ROS; Achane stash only if IR-eligible deep.
items.opportunity: Full backfield opportunity for replacements short-term.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is active vs Cowboys after pregame workout on hamstring; looked good, though likely limited snaps/pitch count.
items.why: Positive 20-min pregame workout in Rio; cleared despite earlier pessimism.
items.implication: Startable with risk; volume may be capped at 20-30 snaps.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets return for Lamar; monitor snap share vs Bateman/Andrews.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall ruled out with thigh injury.
Raiders TE Brock Bowers is active and will make his 2026 season debut vs Saints.
items.why: Cleared after knee issue; listed expected by ETR.
items.opportunity: High target share expected as featured TE.

items.text: Risky but if Flowers is active for Baltimore he's active for me; start him over Bateman.
items.why: Active status overrides prior GTD risk for fantasy start.
items.implication: Prefer Flowers in lineups over secondary Ravens options.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams Grade 2 hamstring: 3-4 week recovery timeline; noted quick healer hoping to beat it.
items.why: Sources confirm timeline on Grade 2 strain.
items.opportunity: Bagent or replacement QB stream; WR/TE volume stable or up.

items.text: Actives include Bills WRs DJ Moore and Keon Coleman; Moore expected/active after shoulder.
items.why: Official actives; limited practice week but no miss since 2020.
items.opportunity: Continued role if not heavily limited.

items.text: Actives include Steelers RB Jaylen Warren; Pittman also expected/active (foot).
items.implication: Warren lead back upside; Pittman WR role intact.
items.opportunity: Increased carries for Warren with Dowdle OUT.

items.text: AD Mitchell expected inactive (finger); Jets WRs: 1. Garrett Wilson 2. Isaiah Williams 3. Pritchett 4. Shepard 5. McLain; TE Sadiq likely slot/wide work.
items.implication: Wilson clear WR1; depth chart compression.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for Wilson and secondary WRs/TE.

items.text: Flowers (ham) out in projs (late Bateman/Andrews DFS); Moore in but limited; Mitchell out. Projecting Warren/Evans/Bowers IN. Jets WR depth post-Mitchell: Wilson, others + Sadiq slot.
items.why: No early clarity on some; data-driven assumptions pending updates.
items.implication: DFS pivots; start expected INs confidently.
items.opportunity: Wilson/others volume with Mitchell out; limited Moore still viable.

items.text: Weekend summary: Flowers GTD (not counting on); Spears hopeful GTD. Expected: Warren, Pittman, Barkley, Smith, Bowers, Evans, Coker, Coleman. Q: Parkinson, Bagent.
items.implication: Core expected players lock starts; Flowers late swap.

items.text: Panthers WR Xavier Legette out, Jalen Coker up/active; positive for Coker role.
Saquon Barkley and Devonta Smith expected to play.
Puka Nacua doubtful (prior report); expected miss, more volume Adams.
items.opportunity: Adams target/route spike; Surtain matchup note.
